units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Wisdom stands on the heights, at the crossroads and city gates, calling all people.
units_chirho.title_chirho: Wisdom calls at the heights and gates

roles_chirho.text_facts_chirho: cries at the heights, crossroads, gates and doors (8:1-3)

art_choices_chirho: Wisdom as a woman follows the personification; keep her consistent through chapter 8 and with 9:1-6

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Her words are truthful and plain; instruction better than silver and gold.
units_chirho.title_chirho: My words are right; better than rubies

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Wisdom dwells with prudence; rulers decree justice by her.

roles_chirho.text_facts_chirho: rule by her (8:15-16); generic, not Solomon

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Riches and honour with her; she walks in the way of righteousness.
units_chirho.title_chirho: I love those who love me

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Before the depths, mountains and fields, Wisdom was there as the LORD established heaven, sea and earth.

roles_chirho.text_facts_chirho: brought forth before creation; beside him as a master workman, rejoicing (8:22-31)

art_choices_chirho: scenes of depths, springs, mountains, sky and sea boundaries
units_chirho.uncertainty_chirho: A time transition back to before creation. God is not depicted as a person (project rule). 8:30 'master workman' or 'little child' is debated.

units_chirho.rationale_chirho: Closing appeal: watching daily at her gates; whoever finds her finds life.
units_chirho.title_chirho: Blessed is the one who listens
